info.name: HookRelay API
info.description:
Comprehensive API test collection for HookRelay webhook delivery platform. Covers event ingestion, endpoint management, health checks, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and edge cases. Requires a running HookRelay backend and valid API key configured in the environment.

IMPORTANT: Replace PLACEHOLDER values in the environment file with real test credentials before running.

request.description: Verifies the HookRelay application is running and healthy. No authentication required.
Ingests a valid event with a unique idempotency key. Expects 202 Accepted.

exec: pm.test("Response body has status ACCEPTED", function () {
